brief: Work item 1 (implementation notes section 1, B1-B5). A project has a seed only where testing.setup builds one; testing.setup null means no seed. Gate each prompt's seed text on that fact: test-write.md (Read 3 reads testing.setup; seed change offered only where a seed exists, else fixture or the test's own setup), test-speed.md (Read, Judge seed paragraph, send-back sentence), test-support.md (drop the close-blocked-where-no-seed instruction; a seed item with no seed lands as a fixture and is marked made), {{TEST-WASTE-RULE}} in _sprint/shared.md (seed bullet conditional), docs/testing.md and docs/plumbline-cheatsheet.md (to the decision's text). In scripts/tests: USAGE support-change text as the notes quote; support_brief takes the testing settings and where testing.setup is null briefs a seed item as 'a fixture (the project holds no seed)', citing @decision: seed-recommended-never-required; stage_write reads testing and passes it through stage_support. SUPPORT_CHANGES keeps seed. Leave F/admin/true-up's citation alone.
result: Seed text in the test-write, test-speed, and test-support prompts, the waste rule, the testing standard, and the rules text is gated on testing.setup building a seed; the support task no longer closes blocked over a seed; tests tasks --stage write reads testing and support_brief briefs a seed item as a fixture where testing.setup is null (@decision: seed-recommended-never-required); 16 sites, 4 standing

brief: Work items 4 and 5 (implementation notes sections 4 and 5, B8-B15). Item 4 in plugins/ok/families/ok-planner/scripts/review: new default_base(root) (HEAD where git rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD^{commit} succeeds, else the empty tree from git hash-object -t tree /dev/null); cmd_changed uses chosen_base(args, root) or default_base(root); round_paths diffs from default_base; cmd_rotate records commit null and prints 'at no commit' with no HEAD; --base help text. Confirm in a scratch repo (in the scratchpad, not the project) that git diff --name-status <empty tree> lists indexed files as added. Item 5: declared_folders(root) returns the list or raises ReviewError with the two messages the notes quote; a list whose entries all normalize to '.' returns [] without node. Remove review::project_folders and tests::project_folders; their callers (tree_files, changed_files; offer_groups, sprint_plan, cmd_groups, assembled_plan) call review.declared_folders(root). cmd_certified drops the 'alone' note. converge/SKILL.md: Fix step 3 snapshot says before the first commit it takes every file; drop every 'reads the project root alone ... quote the note' instruction (preconditions, analysis slice, hunt and sprint return lines) and say a folders refusal stops the run with its message, no return block. .ok-planner/review/project.md Scripts: review entry states before-first-commit behavior of changed, snapshot, rotate, and the folders refusal; tests entry the folders refusal.
result: review defaults to HEAD or git's empty tree before the first commit (changed, snapshot; rotate records commit null, 'at no commit'); declared_folders returns the list or raises on a malformed list or node off PATH beyond the root; project_folders gone from review and tests; converge skill and review project.md updated

brief: Work item 3 (implementation notes section 3, B7). plugins/ok/families/ok-planner/scripts/tasks: refile parser gains --files (action=extend, nargs=+, default None); cmd_refile sets spec files to args.files where given (replaces whole), else the source's, all in the one existing put_many; USAGE refile entry names --files. plugins/ok/families/ok-planner/scripts/tests::filed_tasks refile branch passes --files to tasks refile in one write; remove set_files where nothing else calls it. sprint-document.md How to execute step 7: a partial build whose result starts 'outside files:' is refiled with 'tasks refile <task> --files <its files and that path>'. Then run checks/sprint-boilerplate and fill plugins/ok/families/ok-planner/admin/retired-boilerplate.json with exactly the released lines the new template no longer holds, sorted, as the check computes (lines never released are not added). project.md Scripts tasks entry names refile --files.
result: tasks refile --files replaces the task's file list in the one refile write; tests filed_tasks refiles with --files in one write; step 7 names refile --files; retired-boilerplate.json holds the two retired step-7 lines (sprint-boilerplate passes); project.md names refile --files

brief: Work item 7, tracker part (implementation notes section 7: Calls on retry --all, Changes for tasks and tests, I1, I2, B31, B32). plugins/ok/families/ok-planner/scripts/tasks: new retry_kind (released for running or open pass task; retried for closed with outcome in RETRYABLE and no task naming it previous; else nothing), reset_task (the reset cmd_retry held), retry_records citing @decision: stopped-run-resumes (reset tasks, open non-pass issued waiters whose after names a reopened task set to issued=0, one RELEASED/RETRIED event per reset task with next_ids('e',...), in add_items' shape); cmd_retry takes <task> or --all, refuses both or neither naming the two forms, single form refuses a refiled-away task with 'task tN was refiled as tM; retry tM', both write one put_many; output lines as the notes say, or 'retry: no task to issue again'; parser task nargs='?' plus --all store_true; USAGE entry. plugins/ok/families/ok-planner/scripts/tests: blocked_on_support and its write-stage caller treat a reopened unissued test task with an open support item as blocked on support and add the support task it files to that test task's after in the same filings write. project.md Scripts tasks entry names retry <task> | --all, its refusals, and the un-issuing of waiters.
result: tasks retry takes <task> or --all, issues again in one write with waiters un-issued and refiled-away tasks kept closed; tests --stage write makes a reopened unissued test task with an open support item wait on its support task; project.md names retry's forms and refusals

brief: Work item 7, review part (implementation notes section 7). plugins/ok/families/ok-planner/scripts/review: new STOP_RECORD, stop_record, stop_reason(root, path) (None where no <stem>-stopped.txt stands, else its lines). cmd_certified: after the archived closed: branch and before anything else (before the folders read), where the record stands print 'SPRINT STOPPED: <path>', each reason line as '- <line>' ('no reason recorded' if empty), and a line saying the goal ends and the owner takes up the reason; exit 3; leave -certified.txt as it stands. Cite @decision: every-stop-ends-the-goal and @decision: sprint-goal-read-from-the-repository. brief: Work item 6 (implementation notes section 6, B17) and work item 7's docs part, in plugins/ok/families/ok-planner/scripts/docs. New change_reasons(root, spec, changed, declared) holding window_entry's reason code (window_entry calls it); planned_commit (parses 'Planned against commit `<sha>`.' from the Window section); bearing_docspecs ({slug: reasons} for planned slugs over a diff between two commits); cmd_start and parser 'start --sprint': refuse (exit 1) a sprint with no Window line or a commit the repo lacks; where HEAD is the planned commit or no planned docspec bears on git diff --name-only --no-renames <planned> HEAD print 'start: ...' and exit 0; else list each bearing docspec with reasons, say the plan must be made again, exit 2; writes nothing. cmd_stamp: where the base differs from the planned commit, stamp each planned docspec that commits between the planned commit and the parent of --commit bear on at the planned commit, printing a line; where the Window line cannot be parsed, stamp as today. cmd_complete: after the archived closed: branch, the stop check through review.stop_reason (imported as closed_stamp is), printing DOCS STOPPED and exiting 3, same citations as review's. USAGE adds start, the stamp behavior, the stop record and exit 3.
result: docs now has change_reasons (window_entry calls it), planned_commit, bearing_docspecs, and 'start --sprint' (exit 1 refusal, 0 start, 2 stop listing bearing docspecs); cmd_stamp stamps docspecs later commits bear on at the planned commit; cmd_complete prints DOCS STOPPED exit 3 via review.stop_reason; USAGE updated

brief: Work item 7, sprint template (implementation notes section 7: Calls and the sprint-document.md Changes list, B24-B26). In plugins/ok/families/ok-planner/skills/plan-sprint/sprint-document.md: step 1 stop condition names SPRINT COMPLETE or SPRINT STOPPED and deletes a standing <stem>-stopped.txt before the run goes on; step 2 reordered (approval check, tracker and .claude/agents check, .ok-planner/bin/tests check where the run opens test stages, then only where no base stands the uncommitted-paths check and the base; every pre-run stop writes the stop record then runs review certified; where the base stands keep it; where -certified.txt also stands run review certified and on SPRINT COMPLETE offer the archive); step 3 drops moved checks, and where the run file stands runs tasks use <run file>, tasks retry --all, then every registration and config again, else tasks init; step 4 resume filing rule (no build task for a work item some task's --cites names; test-stage verbs run again from --stage write); step 6 checklist from the run on resume; step 11 at a genuine blocker wait until no agent you started runs, write the stop record, run review certified, stop; step 13 on SPRINT NOT COMPLETE after the veto write the stop record naming each failure, run review certified, stop; archive step 2 names -stopped.txt; goal rule names SPRINT STOPPED as a line that ends the goal while the contract stays unmet. Keep step 7's --files wording from the earlier stage. Then run checks/sprint-boilerplate and fill plugins/ok/families/ok-planner/admin/retired-boilerplate.json exactly as it computes.
result: sprint template: step 1 names SPRINT STOPPED and deletes the stop record; step 2 runs every pre-run check before the base and resumes on a standing base (certified mark offers the archive); step 3 resumes with tasks use + retry --all; steps 4/6 resume rules; step 11 defines the stop record and review certified; step 13, archive, goal rule name it; retired-boilerplate.json filled as checks/sprint-boilerplate computes (passes)

brief: Work items 6 and 7, documentation sprint templates (implementation notes sections 6 and 7, B16, B27-B29). plugins/ok/families/ok-planner/skills/plan-docs/doc-sprint-document.md: step 1 names DOCS STOPPED and deletes the stop record; step 3 the tools check, then docs start --sprint <path> (exit 2 or exit 1: write the stop record with its output, run docs complete, stop), then only where no base stands the uncommitted check and the base; step 4 where the run file stands tasks use and tasks retry --all, then prompts written and registered again and config set again, else tasks init; steps 5-7 file no task whose role and key the run holds, the fact loop continues from the highest round the run records; step 8 a failure the session cannot work writes the record then runs docs complete; goal rule names DOCS STOPPED. plugins/ok/families/ok-planner/skills/_sprint/shared.md: {{CEREMONY-RUN-RULES}} at a genuine blocker wait for in-flight agents, write <stem>-stopped.txt naming the blocker, run docs complete --sprint <path>, stop, a new /goal resumes; {{CEREMONY-ARCHIVE}} step 1 names -stopped.txt; {{PLANNING-HANDOFF}} for a documentation sprint rewrites the Window's Planned against commit line to git rev-parse HEAD after its commits. plugins/ok/families/ok-planner/skills/plan-docs/SKILL.md open documentation sprint: names the stop record's reason, its /goal offer resumes; where the record came from docs start, offer on the owner's yes to move the stale doc sprint and its stop record to .ok-planner/history/doc-sprints/ unstamped and plan again, no /goal offer. Then run checks/sprint-boilerplate and fill plugins/ok/families/ok-planner/admin/retired-doc-sprint-boilerplate.json exactly as it computes.
result: doc sprint template stops before its base (tools, docs start), resumes via tasks use + retry --all, files no task twice, names DOCS STOPPED; run rules write the stop record and run docs complete; archive moves -stopped.txt; handoff rewrites the Window commit; /plan-docs names the stop reason and sets a docs-start-stopped plan aside; retired list filled as checks/sprint-boilerplate computes
